svg.title: Bazaar proposed ownership and reusable asset plan
svg.desc: North-up map of 25 route spaces, 35 registered owner cards and nine added ownership groups. Colors show district floors, solid lines show public and secondary fronts, gray outlines show retained massing. This is a design diagram, not implemented placement authority.
svg.text: PROPOSED • 69/69 inventory entries treated • 56 × 92 m • existing geometry retained
Source snapshot: dev-4 · 6a34462 · 2026-09-04 | Read buildings.md and assets.md before placement.
O08 sealed perimeter • O09 city belts beyond map
Dashed routes show connectivity, not clearance envelopes. P cards own all remaining edges.
Blank wall is an explicit treatment. Open route faces receive no wall, prop or decorative opening.
• West Spice: three complete spice counters; east stays quiet.
• B04 + B17: court and Souk faces of one central block.
• Textile: rug displays inside retained repaired arches.
• T0 booth retained; T1 proposed reuse; D1 dye sample counter.
• Tea: retain ramp/stairs and 1.4 m terrace; no new gallery.
• Dogleg: work wall opposite one dwelling, fewer openings.
• Gates and skyline: retain complete existing assemblies.
• O07: six supported canopy spans + eight drying lines.
1 Complete B21 Dyers House: door, screens, all faces.
2 Complete B18 Souk east: three different trades.
3 Complete B01 Spice block: varied joinery and stock.
4 Approve pilots before compatible assembly reuse.
Then: one booth reuse at T1, after fit and approval.
M01–M05 in README: ownership, fit, support, gate, body sweep.
O01 Bab al-Suq · O02 house backs · O03 dye works
O04 Spice Gate · O05 Rug Gate · O06 North Vista
O07 overheads · O08 boundary · O09 city belts
